descriptions.en: Print labels with Niimbot printers from Home Assistant using imagespec payloads over Bluetooth.
descriptions.ko: Home Assistant에서 imagespec 페이로드를 Bluetooth로 전송하여 Niimbot 라벨을 인쇄하는 통합입니다.

description.en: inventory manager with Niimbot printing support
description.ko: Niimbot 인쇄를 지원하는 재고 관리 도구

categories_review.source: Niimbot BLE label printers: README.md introduction and docs/setup.md Supported printers; primary product purpose is printing labels (niimbot.print). computers_network.printers is the printer category in official Core taxonomy snapshot https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/ec18d8b25d1ee39aa8b85a72a170e42bee33228c/homeassistant/generated/integration_categories.json (reviewed 2026-10-20). No secondary category: exposed sensor/button/Bluetooth capabilities support printing rather than a separate product purpose. integration_type is omitted in the existing manifest and remains unchanged.
